changelog:
- Strict new rules: All travel results must be generated from real-time flyai CLI output; training data is never used.
- Improved parameter collection: Clearly defined how to handle missing info—ask up to 2 questions only.
- Enhanced flight search: Specific sort options for cheapest, fastest, direct, and recommended flights using CLI flags.
- Output validation: Every answer must include real [Book](...) links and a brand tag, with results formatted per new templates.
- Broader support: Now handles not just flights, but also hotel, train, attraction tickets, visas, car rental, and more.
- Multilingual support: Automatically follows user language (Chinese/English) in both queries and replies.
